name: Zoltán Kiss
bio:
Zoltán's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly, tinkering with engines in his uncle's garage in rural Hungary. This early exposure ignited a passion that led him to pursue mechanical engineering, graduating top of his class. He quickly transitioned into racing, starting as a junior mechanic for a small touring car team before steadily climbing the ranks. His meticulous nature and knack for problem-solving caught the eye of RFK Racing, who headhunted him to oversee their operational efficiency.

As Head of Operations, Zoltán is the linchpin ensuring everything runs smoothly behind the scenes. He's known for his data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing processes to identify bottlenecks and implement improvements. While not always the most charismatic, Zoltán's unwavering commitment to precision and his ability to cut through the noise make him an invaluable asset to the team. His colleagues appreciate his straightforward honesty and dedication to achieving results, even under pressure. His ability to identify potential problems before they arise is unmatched.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed to the side with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Zoltán is of average height and build, with a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down observations and ideas.
Insists on starting every meeting precisely on time.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
